pages.text: Feed a half-wave dipole about a third of the way along through a $(item)4:1 balun$() and it matches on its band and the $(thing)2nd and 4th harmonics$() too: a 40 m OCFD (one arm 7, the other 13 blocks: 20 in all) works on 40, 20 and 10 m.$(br2)The short arm must be a third to two thirds of the long one.
